title.zh: 一个八音盒 = 一个音序器
title.en: A music box is a sequencer

lead.zh: 圆筒旋转时，凸起拨动梳齿即可奏出音符。
lead.en: As the cylinder turns, each pin plucks a tooth to play a note.

say.zh: 圆筒旋转时，金属凸起依次拨动梳齿发出声音。
say.en: As the cylinder turns, each pin plucks a metal tooth to sound a note.

say.zh: 把圆筒展开平铺就是音序器：横向表示时间，纵向表示音高，绿色播放头标出当前发声位置。
say.en: Unroll that cylinder and you get a sequencer: time runs left to right, pitch runs bottom to top, and the green playhead shows what is playing right now.

say.zh: 点按空格子可添加一个音符（相当于在圆筒上加一颗凸起），再点一次即可移除。在鸣片上，右侧 4×4 GRID 对应这 16 个时间步，左侧演奏区则用于选择音高。
say.en: Tap an empty cell to place a note (like adding a pin to the cylinder), or tap it again to remove it. On Cardenza, those 16 steps are the 4×4 GRID on the right, while the pads on the left choose the pitch.

title.en: Four music boxes make a loop

lead.zh: 把多种乐器叠加在一起，组成完整的乐段。
lead.en: Combine multiple instruments to build a full groove.

say.zh: 单个八音盒只能演奏一种乐器。
say.en: A single music box only plays one instrument.

say.zh: 再叠加三条轨道，让鼓、钢琴、和弦与贝斯同时合奏。
say.en: Layer three more (drums, piano, chords, and bass) so they all play together.

say.zh: 每个乐器是一条轨道，循环播放的一圈叫做 Pattern。四条轨道协同播放就构成一段完整的循环乐句。
say.en: Each instrument is a track, and its loop is called a pattern. Playing all four tracks together creates a complete musical loop.

title.zh: 很多段排起来 = 一首歌

lead.zh: 把多个短循环按顺序串联，编排成一首完整的歌。
lead.en: Arrange short loops back to back to build a full track.

say.zh: 单个循环通常只有几秒钟。
say.en: A single loop only lasts a few seconds.

say.zh: 准备几个不同段落（前奏、主歌、副歌等），按从左到右的顺序依次衔接播放。
say.en: Create a few sections (intro, verse, chorus, and so on) and play them back to back from left to right.

say.zh: 这样串联起来就是一首歌（SONG）。每个段落里，各轨道可分别指定播放的 Pattern（P01、P02……）或保持静音（`--`）。在鸣片上，歌曲编排位于 {{scene:TAPE}} 场景。
say.en: That sequence of sections is a song. In each section, every track plays one of its patterns (P01, P02, ...) or stays silent (--). On Cardenza, you arrange songs in {{scene:TAPE}}.

lead.zh: 键盘分为四个功能区，各自职责清晰。
lead.en: Four sections, each with a clear role.

say.zh: 中间 8 列是演奏区，按下任意按键即可触发音符。
say.en: The 8 columns in the middle are your playable pads. Press any key to play a note.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 12; tap r3c3; wait 12; tap r3c5

say.zh: 右侧 4×4 GRID 与屏幕中央的格子一一对应，点按即可选中对应项目。
say.en: The 4×4 GRID on the right lines up directly with the cells on screen. Tap a key to select that cell.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}} 调节当前选中项的数值。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}} to adjust the selected value.

steps.demo: tap SUB; tap SUB; tap SUB; tap ADD

say.zh: 最左与最右各 4 颗功能键负责导航、调值与走带控制，可以逐个试按一下：
say.en: The four keys on each outer edge handle navigation, values, and playback. Give them a try:

lead.zh: 弹奏演奏区并快速浏览预设音色。
lead.en: Play the pads and browse presets.

say.zh: 弹奏演奏区按键。与标准钢琴相同，下排为白键、上排为黑键。
say.en: Play the pads. Just like a piano, white keys sit on the bottom row and black keys on the row above.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c2; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10; tap r2c2; wait 90; shot

say.zh: 弹奏演奏区按键。当前为 SCALE 排列，所有键均在选定音阶内，自左向右依次升高，每往上一行高一个八度，左下角为根音。
say.en: Play the pads. In SCALE layout, every key belongs to your selected scale, ascending left to right with each row one octave higher and the root at bottom left.

say.zh: 弹奏演奏区按键。当前为 CHROMA 半音排列，从左下角起向右每键升高一个半音，每行 8 键依次向上延续。
say.en: Play the pads. In CHROMA layout, every key plays a note, rising one semitone per key from bottom left across each row of 8.

keymarks.en: White keys starting at C3 (bottom left)

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 或 {{key:SUB}} 切换预设音色，当前音色名显示在屏幕顶部。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} or {{key:SUB}} to switch presets. The preset name appears at the top of the screen.

say.zh: 再弹奏几下，试听切换后的新音色。
say.en: Play the pads again to hear the new preset.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10; tap r3c5

lead.zh: 顶层界面称为场景，每个场景下包含多个子页面。
lead.en: Top-level views are called scenes, and each scene contains multiple pages.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 依次切换场景：{{scene:INSTR}}（音色）→ {{scene:SEQ}}（音序）→ {{scene:TAPE}}（编排）。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} to cycle scenes: {{scene:INSTR}} (sound) → {{scene:SEQ}} (notes) → {{scene:TAPE}} (arrangement).

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}} 展开场景地图，GRID 的每一列对应一个场景。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} to open the scene map, with one column per scene.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; up ESC

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}} 同时点按 GRID 任意一列，即可直达对应场景。
say.en: While holding {{key:ESC}}, tap any GRID column to jump straight to that scene.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; tap G4; wait 6; shot; up ESC

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 切换到当前场景的下一页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} to move to the next page in the current scene.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}} 展开页面地图，当前场景的全部子页会铺在 GRID 上。
say.en: Hold {{key:CTRL}} to display every page of the current scene on the GRID.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; shot; up CTRL

say.zh: 按住 {{key:CTRL}} 同时点按对应格子，即可直接跳转到该页面。
say.en: While holding {{key:CTRL}}, tap a GRID key to jump straight to that page.

steps.demo: down CTRL; wait 30; tap G1; wait 6; shot; up CTRL

lead.zh: 每条轨道就像乐队中的一位乐手（鼓、键盘、和弦、贝斯），各自演奏独立声部。鸣片提供四条按颜色区分的轨道。
lead.en: Think of each track as a musician in a band: drums, keys, chords, and bass all playing together. Cardenza has four color-coded tracks.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:TAB}} 切换到下一条轨道，屏幕顶部的轨道颜色会随之更新。
say.en: Tap {{key:TAB}} to switch to the next track. Notice the track color update at the top of the screen.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 展开轨道地图，GRID 上每列对应一条轨道。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} to open the track map, with one column per track.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; shot; up TAB

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 并点按 GRID 第 1 行任意格，即可直达对应轨道。
say.en: While holding {{key:TAB}}, tap a key in the top row of the GRID to jump straight to that track.

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G3; wait 6; shot; up TAB

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 并点按 GRID 1，切回 {{track:1}}（鼓轨）。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 1 to return to {{track:1}} (drums).

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G1; up TAB

lead.zh: 接下来五课将带你从零完成一首完整作品。先从基础鼓点开始，依次写入底鼓、军鼓与闭镲。
lead.en: Over the next five lessons, you will build a complete song from scratch. Start by programming a basic kick, snare, and hi-hat beat.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 进入 {{scene:SEQ}} 编写节奏与音符。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} to open {{scene:SEQ}}, where you program beats and notes.

say.zh: 当前为鼓机视图，演奏区每列对应一种鼓。按住第 1 列最上方的键（底鼓 BD）并依次点按 GRID 1、5、9、13，在四拍上写入底鼓。
say.en: This is the drum sequencer, with one drum per pad column. Hold the top pad in column 1 (kick, BD) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9, and 13 to place kicks on all four beats.

steps.demo: down r0c1; wait 10; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c1; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}} 启动播放，绿色播放头扫过时即会触发底鼓。保持播放继续下一步。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} to hear your kick pattern loop as the green playhead sweeps across. Leave it running.

say.zh: 按住第 2 列最上方的键（军鼓 SD）并点按 GRID 5 和 13，在第 2、4 拍加入军鼓。
say.en: Hold the top pad in column 2 (snare, SD) and tap GRID 5 and 13 to add snares on beats 2 and 4.

steps.demo: down r0c2; wait 10; tap G5; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c2; wait 20

say.zh: 用同样的方法加入闭镲（CH）：按住第 3 列最上方的键，依次点按 GRID 3、7、11、15。
say.en: Do the same for the closed hi-hat (CH): hold the top pad in column 3 and tap GRID 3, 7, 11, and 15.

steps.demo: down r0c3; wait 10; tap G3; tap G7; tap G11; tap G15; wait 10; up r0c3; wait 20

say.zh: 再按一次 {{key:PLAY}} 停止播放。这段基础鼓点已保存在 P01 中。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again to stop. Your beat is now saved in pattern P01.

lead.zh: 一首完整的歌需要段落变化。把 P01 复制为 P02 并加倍踩镲密度，作为副歌鼓点。
lead.en: A good song needs variation. Duplicate P01 into P02 and add extra hi-hats to build energy for the chorus.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 进入 PATTERN 页，每个格子代表一个 Pattern 槽位，目前只有 P01。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} to open the PATTERN page. Each GRID cell is a pattern slot; right now only P01 exists.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:FN}} 并按 D 键，即可将 P01 复制为 P02。
say.en: Hold {{key:FN}} and press D to duplicate P01 into P02.

steps.demo: down FN; wait 20; tap r2c4; up FN; wait 10

say.zh: 点按 GRID 2 切换至 P02。
say.en: Tap GRID 2 to select P02.

say.zh: 连按两次 {{key:CTRL}} 返回鼓机页面。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} twice to return to the drum sequencer.

steps.demo: tap CTRL; wait 10; tap CTRL; wait 10

say.zh: 按住第 3 列最上方的闭镲（CH），点按 GRID 1、5、9、13，让 P02 的踩镲节奏加倍。
say.en: Hold the top pad in column 3 (CH) and tap GRID 1, 5, 9, and 13 to double the hi-hat rhythm in P02.

steps.demo: down r0c3; wait 10; tap G1; tap G5; tap G9; tap G13; wait 10; up r0c3; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}} 试听加厚后的 P02。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} to listen to P02.

say.zh: 再次按 {{key:PLAY}} 停止播放。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again to stop.

lead.zh: 第 3 轨是电钢琴。开启单键和弦模式，快速写入 Am 与 F 两个和弦进行。
lead.en: Track 3 is an electric piano. Turn on Chord mode so each pad plays a full chord, then program an Am and F progression.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 并点按 GRID 3，切换到 {{track:3}}（电钢琴）。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 3 to switch to {{track:3}} (electric piano).

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G3; up TAB; wait 10

say.zh: 连按两次 {{key:ESC}} 进入 {{scene:INSTR}} 调整当前轨道设置。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} twice to open {{scene:INSTR}} for this track.

steps.demo: tap ESC; wait 10; tap ESC; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 打开 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} to open the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点按 CHORD（GRID 1）启用和弦模式。
say.en: Tap CHORD (GRID 1) to enable chord mode.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 返回 {{scene:SEQ}} 编写和弦进行。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} to return to {{scene:SEQ}} and sequence the chords.

say.zh: 按住下排第 6 个白键（A 音）并点按 GRID 1、4、7，写入三拍 Am 和弦。
say.en: Hold A (6th white key on the bottom row) and tap GRID 1, 4, and 7 to enter three Am chords.

steps.demo: down r3c6; wait 10; tap G1; tap G4; tap G7; wait 10; up r3c6; wait 10

say.zh: 接下来改按下排第 4 个白键（F 音），点按 GRID 9、12、15 写入 F 和弦。
say.en: Now do the same with F (4th white key on the bottom row): hold F and tap GRID 9, 12, and 15.

steps.demo: down r3c4; wait 10; tap G9; tap G12; tap G15; wait 10; up r3c4; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}} 试听鼓点与电钢琴和弦的合奏效果。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} to hear the drums and electric piano together.

say.zh: 再次按 {{key:PLAY}} 停止播放。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again to stop.

lead.zh: 切换到第 2 轨（Juno 合成器），用白键编写一段简洁的 6 音主旋律。
lead.en: Switch to Track 2 (Juno synth) and program a simple 6-note melody using only white keys.

say.zh: 按住 {{key:TAB}} 并点按 GRID 2，切换到 {{track:2}}（Juno 合成器）。
say.en: Hold {{key:TAB}} and tap GRID 2 to select {{track:2}} (Juno synth).

steps.demo: down TAB; wait 30; tap G2; up TAB; wait 10

say.zh: 按住高八度白键行的第 6 个键（A 音）并点按 GRID 1，写入旋律首音。
say.en: Hold A (6th white key on the upper octave row) and tap GRID 1 to place the first note.

steps.demo: down r1c6; wait 10; tap G1; wait 10; up r1c6; wait 10

say.zh: 按相同方式对照下方提示写入其余 5 个音符：
say.en: Repeat the same technique for the remaining 5 notes shown below:

steps.keys: r1c5 r1c3 r1c4 r1c1 G4 G7 G12 G9 G15
steps.demo: down r1c5; wait 6; tap G4; up r1c5; down r1c3; wait 6; tap G7; tap G12; up r1c3; down r1c4; wait 6; tap G9; up r1c4; down r1c1; wait 6; tap G15; up r1c1; wait 10

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}} 试听鼓、和弦与旋律三轨合奏。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} to hear the drums, chords, and melody together.

say.zh: 再次按 {{key:PLAY}} 停止播放。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} again to stop.

lead.zh: 将键盘锁定至指定音阶，避免弹出调外错音。
lead.en: Lock the keyboard to a musical scale so every pad stays in key.

say.zh: 随意弹奏几个琴键，会发现有些音组合起来很和谐，有些则显得跑调。下面把键盘切换为音阶模式，让每颗键都留在调内。
say.en: Try playing a few random pads. Some combinations sound great, while others clash. Let's configure the keyboard so every pad plays an in-key note.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 12; tap r2c2; wait 12; tap r3c4; wait 12; tap r2c5; wait 12; tap r3c7

say.zh: 按住 {{key:ESC}} 并点按 GRID 第 1 列任意键进入 {{scene:SETUP}}。
say.en: Hold {{key:ESC}} and press any key in GRID column 1 to open {{scene:SETUP}}.

steps.demo: down ESC; wait 30; shot; tap G1; up ESC

say.zh: 连按两次 {{key:CTRL}} 翻至 KEYS 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} twice to reach the KEYS page.

say.zh: 点按 SCALE（GRID 2）将其聚焦。
say.en: Tap SCALE (GRID 2) to focus it.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 切换为其他音阶。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} to pick a different scale.

say.zh: 点按 LAYOUT（GRID 1）将其聚焦。
say.en: Tap LAYOUT (GRID 1) to focus it.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 切换为 SCALE 排列。此后演奏区所有按键均属于当前音阶。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} to switch to SCALE layout. Now every pad plays a note in the selected scale.

say.zh: 再试弹几下，现在所有按键都会自然合调。
say.en: Play the pads again. Every key now stays in key.

steps.demo: tap r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c2; wait 10; tap r3c3; wait 10

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 退出 SETUP 返回原场景。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} to exit SETUP and return to your previous scene.

lead.zh: 单指触发完整和弦，并用琶音器自动分解演奏。
lead.en: Play full chords and arpeggios with a single finger.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 打开 CHORD 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} to open the CHORD page.

say.zh: 点按 CHORD（GRID 1）启用和弦模式。
say.en: Tap CHORD (GRID 1) to enable chord mode.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 切换其他和弦类型。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} to cycle to another chord type.

say.zh: 按下任意琴键，多个组成音会同时奏响并在屏幕上同步高亮。
say.en: Press any pad to hear multiple notes trigger together as a chord. The screen highlights all chord tones.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 10; shot; up r3c1; wait 10; tap r3c3

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 进入 ARP 页。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} to open the ARP page.

say.zh: 点按 ARP（GRID 1）开启琶音器。
say.en: Tap ARP (GRID 1) to turn on the arpeggiator.

say.zh: 按住一个琴键不放，和弦组成音会按节拍依次分解奏出。
say.en: Hold down a pad to hear the chord's notes arpeggiate one after another.

steps.demo: down r3c1; wait 60; shot; wait 20; up r3c1

lead.zh: 所有素材已就绪：鼓轨 P01 / P02、电钢琴和弦与主旋律。现在到 SONG 页把它们编排成前奏、主歌、副歌与尾声。
lead.en: You have all the pieces: drum patterns P01 and P02, chords, and melody. Now arrange them into an intro, verse, chorus, and outro on the SONG page.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:ESC}} 进入 {{scene:TAPE}} 进行整曲编排。
say.en: Tap {{key:ESC}} to enter {{scene:TAPE}}, where you arrange and mix all four tracks.

say.zh: 单击 {{key:CTRL}} 打开 SONG 页：每一列为一个段落（从左向右顺次播放），每一行对应一条轨道。
say.en: Tap {{key:CTRL}} to open SONG. Each column is a song section (played left to right) and each row is a track.

say.zh: 点按 `+` 列（GRID 1）添加第 1 段作为前奏。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 1) to add section 1 (your intro).

say.zh: 连按两次 {{key:SUB}} 将 {{track:1}} 设为 `--`，让前奏先不进鼓。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}} twice to set {{track:1}} to `--`, leaving the drums silent during the intro.

steps.demo: tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 点按第 1 段的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 5）将其选中。
say.en: Tap the {{track:2}} cell in section 1 (GRID 5) to select it.

say.zh: 按 {{key:SUB}} 将 {{track:2}} 也设为 `--`，前奏仅保留电钢琴和弦。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}} to set {{track:2}} to `--` as well, leaving just the electric piano for the intro.

say.zh: 再次点按 GRID 5 聚焦小节数，按 {{key:ADD}} 将前奏长度设为 2 小节（`x2`）。
say.en: Tap GRID 5 again to focus the section's bar count, then press {{key:ADD}} so the intro plays for 2 bars (`x2`).

steps.demo: tap G5; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 10

say.zh: 再点一次 GRID 5 切回编辑 Pattern。
say.en: Tap GRID 5 once more to return focus to the pattern.

say.zh: 点按 `+` 列（GRID 2）添加第 2 段作为主歌，默认会复制前奏配置。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 2) to add section 2 (the verse), which starts as a copy of the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 将 {{track:1}} 设为 P01，在主歌引入鼓点。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} to set {{track:1}} to P01 and bring in the drums.

say.zh: 再次点按 GRID 2 聚焦小节数，连按两次 {{key:ADD}} 将主歌设为 4 小节。
say.en: Tap GRID 2 again to focus the bar count, then press {{key:ADD}} twice to make the verse 4 bars long.

steps.demo: tap G2; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 6; tap ADD; wait 10

say.zh: 再点一次 GRID 2 切回编辑 Pattern。
say.en: Tap GRID 2 once more to return focus to the pattern.

say.zh: 点按 `+` 列（GRID 3）添加第 3 段作为副歌。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 3) to add section 3 (the chorus).

say.zh: 按 {{key:ADD}} 将 {{track:1}} 切换为更密集的 P02 鼓点。
say.en: Press {{key:ADD}} to switch {{track:1}} to the busier P02 drum pattern.

say.zh: 点按副歌的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 7）并按 {{key:ADD}}，在副歌加入主旋律。
say.en: Tap the {{track:2}} cell in section 3 (GRID 7) and press {{key:ADD}} to bring in the melody.

steps.demo: tap G7; wait 10; tap ADD; wait 6

say.zh: 点按 `+` 列（GRID 4）添加末段作为尾声。
say.en: Tap the + column (GRID 4) to add the final section (the outro).

say.zh: 连按两次 {{key:SUB}} 将 {{track:1}} 设回 `--`。
say.en: Press {{key:SUB}} twice to set {{track:1}} back to `--`.

steps.demo: tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 点按尾声的 {{track:2}} 格（GRID 8）并按 {{key:SUB}}，关闭尾声的主旋律。
say.en: Tap the {{track:2}} cell in section 4 (GRID 8) and press {{key:SUB}} to mute the melody too.

steps.demo: tap G8; wait 10; tap SUB; wait 6

say.zh: 再次点按 GRID 8 聚焦小节数，连按两次 {{key:SUB}} 将尾声缩短至 2 小节。
say.en: Tap GRID 8 again to focus the bar count, then press {{key:SUB}} twice to shorten the outro to 2 bars.

steps.demo: tap G8; wait 10; tap SUB; wait 6; tap SUB; wait 10

say.zh: 点按第 1 段的 {{track:1}} 格（GRID 1）把光标移回前奏。
say.en: Tap the {{track:1}} cell in section 1 (GRID 1) to move the cursor back to the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:OK}} 开启 SONG 模式并从前奏起播。
say.en: Press {{key:OK}} to activate SONG mode starting from the intro.

say.zh: 按 {{key:PLAY}} 完整试听你的第一首歌，顺次经过前奏、主歌、副歌与尾声。
say.en: Press {{key:PLAY}} to listen to your finished song play through intro, verse, chorus, and outro.

say.zh: 听完后按 {{key:PLAY}} 停止。整首编排会自动保留在设备上。
say.en: When you are done listening, press {{key:PLAY}} to stop. Your song is automatically saved on the device.

lead.zh: 鸣片开机首先进入 203 启动器，所有固件安装、切换与更新都在此完成。
lead.en: Cardenza boots into the 203 Launcher first, where you install, switch, and update firmware.

say.zh: 插上 USB 线即开机。若已安装固件，203 标志下方会短暂提示「按 FN 进入 Launcher」，约 1 秒后自动进入上次使用的固件（可在 Settings › Boot 中关闭「启动上次的软件」）。
say.en: Plugging in USB powers Cardenza on. If firmware is installed, the boot screen briefly shows "Press FN to enter Launcher" before starting your last app after about a second (you can disable this in Settings › Boot by turning off Boot last app).

say.zh: 如需停留在启动器：按住左侧第 3 颗键 {{key:FN}} 插上 USB 线，待主屏幕出现后松开；或在开机提示出现时单击 {{key:FN}}。（0.2.0 旧版启动器不支持 FN，请在屏幕点亮瞬间按一下左侧 {{key:HOME}} 键。）
say.en: To stay in the Launcher, hold {{key:FN}} (third key down on the left column) while plugging in USB and release once the home screen appears, or tap {{key:FN}} during the boot prompt. (On Launcher 0.2.0, tap the side {{key:HOME}} button as soon as the screen lights up instead.)

say.zh: 从运行中的固件返回启动器：支持系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）按一下侧面 {{key:HOME}} 键，用 {{key:.}} 选中「返回启动器」后按 {{key:OK}}；无系统菜单的固件请拔掉 USB 线，按住 {{key:FN}} 重新插上。
say.en: From running firmware with a system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1+), press the side {{key:HOME}} button, move to Back to Launcher with {{key:.}}, and press {{key:OK}}. On firmware without a system menu, unplug USB, hold {{key:FN}}, and plug back in.

say.zh: 除非准备进行恢复刷机，否则插线时切勿按住 {{key:HOME}}，否则会进入黑屏下载模式（拔线重插即可恢复正常）。
say.en: Do not hold {{key:HOME}} while plugging in USB unless you are doing a recovery flash. That boots the ESP32 into download mode with a blank screen (unplug and reconnect to exit).

say.zh: 启动器使用键帽上的黄色方向丝印导航：{{key:,}} {{key:/}} {{key:;}} {{key:.}} 对应左、右、上、下，{{key:OK}} 确认，{{key:ESC}} 返回。主屏卡片横向排布，首张为「本地应用」（在主屏按 {{key:ESC}} 可快速回到首张卡片）。
say.en: Navigate the Launcher using the yellow arrow legends printed on the keycaps: {{key:,}} {{key:/}} {{key:;}} {{key:.}} for left, right, up, and down, {{key:OK}} to confirm, and {{key:ESC}} to go back. Home screen cards scroll horizontally starting with My Apps (press {{key:ESC}} to jump back to the first card).

say.zh: 启动器默认显示英文。打开主屏第 8 张卡片 Language 并选择「简体中文」即可切换。后续教程均采用中文界面名并附带英文对照。
say.en: The Launcher defaults to English. Open the Language card (8th card on the home screen) to switch languages. These lessons use the English labels.

say.zh: 打开已安装固件：进入「本地应用」（My Apps），选中目标固件并按 {{key:OK}}（启动）。
say.en: To launch an installed app, open My Apps, highlight the firmware, and press {{key:OK}} (Launch).

lead.zh: 最快捷的安装方式：在电脑 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开固件页面，直接通过 USB 刷入，无需登录账号。
lead.en: The quickest way to install firmware: open its page in Chrome or Edge and install over USB. No account required.

say.zh: 在电脑的 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开 203 社区的目标固件页面（例如 Cardenza Synth：[stage.203.io/V6QK28](https://stage.203.io/V6QK28)），用支持数据传输的 USB 线连接开机状态的鸣片（停在启动器或运行固件中均可）。
say.en: Open the firmware's page on the 203 Community in Chrome or Edge on a computer (for example, Cardenza Synth at [stage.203.io/V6QK28](https://stage.203.io/V6QK28)). Connect your Cardenza using a USB data cable and leave it powered on, either in the Launcher or running firmware.

say.zh: 选择发布渠道（稳定版、开发版等），点击「用 USB 线安装」→「连接设备并安装」。若浏览器请求 MIDI 权限请点击允许（用于自动将运行中的固件重启回启动器），首次连接还需在串口列表中选择 USB JTAG/serial debug unit。
say.en: Select a release channel (stable, dev, etc.), click Install over USB, then click Connect and install. Allow MIDI access if prompted so the page can reboot running firmware into the Launcher, and select the device port (USB JTAG/serial debug unit) the first time.

say.zh: 页面会自动完成下载、写入与校验，随后设备自动重启进入新固件。刷写完成前请勿拔线或关闭网页。SD 卡上的工程、采样与设置均不受影响。
say.en: The page downloads, flashes, and verifies the firmware, then reboots your Cardenza into the new version. Keep the cable plugged in and the tab open until it finishes. Projects, samples, and settings on your SD card remain untouched.

say.zh: 若网页提示「在设备上回到启动器」（说明自动进入固件速度快于网页拦截）：支持系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）请按 {{key:HOME}} 选「返回启动器」，待启动器出现后点击网页上的「连接启动器」并选择串口；无系统菜单的固件则先按住 {{key:FN}} 再点「连接启动器」，看到启动器界面后松开。
say.en: If the page prompts "Bring the device back to its Launcher" (because the app booted before the page could catch it): on firmware with a system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1+), press {{key:HOME}} and select Back to Launcher, then click Connect to the Launcher and choose the serial port. On firmware without a system menu, hold {{key:FN}}, click Connect to the Launcher, and release once the Launcher appears.

say.zh: 完成账号绑定后（见[绑定账号](/guide/sign-in/)），固件页主按钮变为「下载并安装」（已有旧版时为绿色「升级」），USB 安装移至右侧 ▾ 菜单内。只要鸣片在启动器中连着 Wi-Fi，就会自动无线下载并安装；若当时离线，重新上线后会弹出「安装来自社区的固件？」，按 {{key:OK}} 确认即可。
say.en: Once your Cardenza is linked to your account ([Binding your account](/guide/sign-in/)), the main button becomes Download & install (or a green Upgrade button if an older version is installed), and Install over USB moves into the ▾ menu beside it. When the device is on Wi-Fi in the Launcher, it downloads and installs automatically. If it was offline when queued, confirm "Install from the community?" with {{key:OK}} when it reconnects.

lead.zh: 无需电脑，在启动器中连接 Wi-Fi 即可直接从 203 社区下载安装固件。
lead.en: Download and install firmware directly over Wi-Fi from the 203 Community without a computer.

say.zh: 在主屏幕翻到「应用商店」（Store）按 {{key:OK}}。首次使用会自动扫描周边 Wi-Fi：选择网络、输入密码并按 {{key:OK}}（也可先在「Wi-Fi 连接」卡片中连网）。
say.en: Scroll to the Store card on the home screen and press {{key:OK}}. On first use, it scans for nearby Wi-Fi networks: choose yours, enter the password, and press {{key:OK}} (or connect beforehand via the Wi-Fi Network card).

say.zh: 商店展示 203 社区精选固件及封面，官方固件作者名前带有认证对勾；已安装且有新版稳定版的固件会置顶并在封面左上角以绿色标注新版本号。选中目标后按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: The Store lists featured community firmware with cover art. Official firmware shows a checkmark next to the author, and installed apps with available stable updates appear first with the new version number in green on the corner. Select an app and press {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 未列入精选的固件可通过 6 位社区代码查找（如 Cardenza Synth 为 `V6QK28`）。在应用商店中直接用键盘输入代码，该固件会自动置顶，按 {{key:OK}} 即可进入。（0.3.0 版启动器请按 {{key:;}} 移至顶部工具栏，选 #「代码」输入后按 {{key:OK}}。）
say.en: Looking for something not listed? Every firmware has a 6-character code on its community page (Cardenza Synth is `V6QK28`). Start typing the code in the Store to jump it to the top, then press {{key:OK}}. (On Launcher 0.3.0, press {{key:;}} to reach the top toolbar, select # Code, enter the code, and press {{key:OK}}.)

say.zh: 选择发布渠道并按 {{key:OK}}：稳定版为正式验证版本，测试版用于公测新特性，开发版为最新代码自动构建（可能包含不稳定改动）。
say.en: Pick a release channel and press {{key:OK}}: stable for tested releases, beta for pre-release testing, or dev for automated bleeding-edge builds.

say.zh: 若设备已装有该固件，系统会询问安装位置：默认选中原位置进行覆盖替换，按 {{key:/}} 选「空闲空间」则另装一份。确认替换时会弹出「替换？」（默认光标在「返回」），按 {{key:,}} 选「替换」再按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: If that firmware is already installed, choose whether to overwrite the existing slot (default) or press {{key:/}} to install a second copy in Free space. Overwriting asks "Replace?" with Back focused by default: press {{key:,}} to select Replace, then press {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 下载、写入与校验期间请保持供电。提示「已安装」后，选择「启动」立即运行新固件，或选择「返回」重启回启动器。
say.en: Keep power connected while it downloads, writes, and verifies. Once "Installed" appears, choose Launch to open the firmware immediately or Back to restart into the Launcher.

say.zh: 后续可通过「本地应用」或「应用商店」封面左上角的绿色角标查看更新，或打开商店顶部工具栏最右侧的「更新」批量升级。升级仅替换固件程序，SD 卡上的工程、采样和设置完好保留。
say.en: To update later, look for the green corner badge in My Apps or the Store, or open Updates on the right side of the Store's top toolbar. Updating only replaces the firmware binary; your projects, samples, and settings stay safe on the SD card.

lead.zh: 将鸣片绑定至 203 社区账号后，即可在网页端无线推送固件与启动器升级。（USB 刷入无需登录账号。）
lead.en: Link your Cardenza to your 203 Community account to push firmware and Launcher updates wirelessly from the web. (USB installs do not require an account.)

say.zh: 先在电脑浏览器登录 [203 社区](https://stage.203.io/)，并让鸣片停留在已连接 Wi-Fi 的启动器界面。
say.en: Sign in to the [203 Community](https://stage.203.io/) on your computer, and leave your Cardenza in the Launcher connected to Wi-Fi.

say.zh: 在启动器主屏打开第 9 张卡片「账号」（Account）即可查看激活网址与登录码（0.3.0 版位于 系统设置 › 账号 › 绑定账号）。未连 Wi-Fi 时会先引导配网。
say.en: Open the Account card (9th card on the home screen) to display the activation URL and sign-in code. (On Launcher 0.3.0, go to System Settings › Account › Bind account.) If Wi-Fi is not connected, you will be prompted to join a network first.

say.zh: 屏幕会显示绑定网址、8 位登录码（10 分钟内有效）以及由芯片唯一决定的设备编号（重刷固件不变）。在电脑端打开[社区绑定页面](https://stage.203.io/activate)，输入登录码并核对设备编号后点击「批准」。
say.en: The screen displays a URL, an 8-character code (valid for 10 minutes), and your hardware device ID (tied to the chip, unchanged across reflashes). Open the [activation page](https://stage.203.io/activate) on your computer, enter the code, verify the device ID, and click Approve.

say.zh: 数秒后鸣片会提示「账号已绑定」，同时出现在网页端的「我的设备」列表中，可在网页改名或解绑。网页解绑后设备端显示「绑定已失效」，也可直接在设备「账号」页选择「解除绑定」。
say.en: After a few seconds, Cardenza displays "Account bound" and appears under My devices on the website, where you can rename or unlink it. Unlinking from the web shows "Binding no longer valid" on the device, or you can unlink directly from Account › Unbind.

say.zh: 无法连接 Wi-Fi 时，0.3.0 及以上启动器支持 USB 绑定：在 Chrome / Edge 中进入「我的设备」›「添加设备」›「用 USB 线」，连接开机状态的鸣片并点击「连接设备」，网页会自动将账号信息写入启动器。
say.en: No Wi-Fi available? On Launcher 0.3.0+, link over USB instead: open My devices › Add a device › With a USB cable in Chrome or Edge, connect your powered-on Cardenza, and click Connect the device to write your account directly into the Launcher.

lead.zh: 启动器是鸣片的底层引导菜单，负责安装和启动所有固件。更新仅替换启动器本身，已安装固件、SD 卡文件与已存 Wi-Fi 均不受影响。
lead.en: The Launcher is the boot menu that installs and launches firmware. Updating only replaces the Launcher itself; installed apps, SD card files, and saved Wi-Fi networks remain intact.

say.zh: 先返回启动器：支持系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）按一下侧面 {{key:HOME}} 键，用 {{key:.}} 选中「返回启动器」并按 {{key:OK}}，设备即重启停在启动器主界面。
say.en: First, return to the Launcher. On firmware with a system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1+), press the side {{key:HOME}} button, scroll down with {{key:.}} to Back to Launcher, and press {{key:OK}}. The device reboots straight to the Launcher home screen.

say.zh: 无系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.0 及更早版本、部分社区固件）：先拔掉 USB 线，按住左侧第 3 颗键 {{key:FN}} 重新插上，待启动器主屏出现后松开（也可在开机提示时单击 {{key:FN}}）。0.2.0 旧版启动器不支持 FN，请在屏幕亮起瞬间按一下 {{key:HOME}}。
say.en: On firmware without a system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.0 or older, and many community apps), unplug USB, hold {{key:FN}} (third key down on the left column), plug back in, and release when the Launcher appears (or tap {{key:FN}} during the boot prompt). On Launcher 0.2.0, tap {{key:HOME}} as soon as the screen turns on.

say.zh: 最便捷的在线更新方式（启动器 0.3.0 起，需连 Wi-Fi）：在主屏找到「更新启动器」（0.3.0–0.3.1 为第 7 张卡片，0.3.2 起位于最末叫「Launcher 更新」），按 {{key:OK}} 检查新版。若提示「未连接」，按 {{key:OK}} 接入 Wi-Fi 即可。
say.en: The easiest way to update over Wi-Fi (Launcher 0.3.0+) is right from the home screen: open Update Launcher (7th card on 0.3.0–0.3.1, last card on 0.3.2+) and press {{key:OK}} to check for updates. If Wi-Fi is not connected yet, press {{key:OK}} when "Not connected" appears to join your network.

say.zh: 检测到新版后，页面会展示版本跨度（如 0.3.1 → 0.3.2）与更新日志（用 {{key:;}} / {{key:.}} 滚动）。按 {{key:OK}}（更新）并保持供电，设备完成下载校验后会自动重启。0.3.2 调整了主屏卡片顺序：本地应用、应用商店、Wi-Fi 连接、文件浏览、U盘模式、远程访问、系统设置、语言、账号、Launcher 更新。
say.en: If an update is available, the screen shows the version jump (such as 0.3.1 → 0.3.2) and release notes (scroll with {{key:;}} and {{key:.}}). Press {{key:OK}} (Update) and keep power connected while it downloads, verifies, and reboots. Launcher 0.3.2 reorganizes the home cards into: My Apps, Store, Wi-Fi Network, Files, USB Drive, Remote Access, Settings, Language, Account, and Update Launcher.

say.zh: 已绑定账号的设备也可在 [203 社区](https://stage.203.io/) 网页端升级（启动器 0.3.0 起）：进入「我的设备」，点击绿色的「升级启动器」并确认「升级」。设备在启动器连网状态或运行 Cardenza Synth 0.2.2+ 时均可自动接收（后者会先保存进度再退回启动器；更早固件需先手动回到启动器），若弹出「更新 Launcher？」按 {{key:OK}} 确认。未绑定设备可通过 USB 线在「我的设备」›「添加设备」›「用 USB 线绑定」免码绑定（或 USB 刷入固件后一键绑定），也可打开设备「账号」卡片用 8 位登录码绑定。
say.en: You can also trigger updates from the [203 Community](https://stage.203.io/) if your device is linked (Launcher 0.3.0+): open My devices, click the green Upgrade Launcher button, and confirm Upgrade. Cardenza receives the update over Wi-Fi while in the Launcher or while running Cardenza Synth 0.2.2+ (which saves your session and reboots to the Launcher; older firmware must be in the Launcher first). Confirm "Update Launcher?" with {{key:OK}} if prompted. To link a device quickly without Wi-Fi, plug it in and use My devices › Add a device › Bind with a USB cable (or click Bind to my account after a USB firmware install), or enter the 8-character code from the Launcher's Account card.

say.zh: 0.2.0 旧版启动器没有独立更新入口，也不支持网页升级：请进入 Download Software，选择 203-Launcher 及最新版本点击 Install；弹出 Update Launcher? 时按 {{key:,}} 选中 Update 并按 {{key:OK}}，重启后即升级至最新版（0.3.2）。（0.2.0 仅含英文界面，图示为新版启动器开机画面。）
say.en: Launcher 0.2.0 does not have an Update Launcher card or web upgrades. Instead, open Download Software, select 203-Launcher, pick the latest version, and choose Install. When prompted "Update Launcher?", press {{key:,}} to highlight Update and press {{key:OK}}. Once it reboots, you will be on the latest Launcher (0.3.2). (0.2.0 is English-only; the preview shows the new Launcher booting.)

say.zh: 若启动器损坏或无法开机，可在电脑 Chrome / Edge 打开[恢复刷机](https://stage.203.io/recover)，选择 Cardenza 并通过 USB 重刷最新官方启动器（可勾选同时刷入 Cardenza Synth）。该操作会清空内部闪存（已装固件、启动器设置、Wi-Fi 与账号绑定），SD 卡内容保持不变。无法正常开机时，按住侧面 HOME 键插上 USB 线并在 2 秒后松开（黑屏为正常下载模式）。
say.en: If the Launcher is corrupted or won't boot, open [Recovery flash](https://stage.203.io/recover) in Chrome or Edge, select Cardenza, and reflash the latest official Launcher (and optionally Cardenza Synth) over USB. Recovery erases internal flash (installed apps, Launcher settings, Wi-Fi credentials, and account link), while leaving the SD card untouched. If the device will not boot normally, hold HOME while plugging in USB and release after two seconds (the screen should stay blank).

title.zh: 设备连不上、启动器无法更新：用网页刷成最新启动器
title.en: Can't connect or update? Flash the Launcher over USB

lead.zh: 0.2.0 和 0.3.0 版本在设备上直接 Wi-Fi 更新时容易超时或连不上服务器。通过此网页 USB 刷写方式仅替换启动器，完整保留已装固件、SD 卡文件、Wi-Fi 配置与账号绑定，无需登录。
lead.en: Launchers 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 can fail or stall during Wi-Fi updates. Use this quick USB flash from the web to update only the Launcher without erasing installed apps, SD card files, Wi-Fi settings, or your account link. No login required.

say.zh: 准备一台装有 Chrome 或 Edge 的电脑（手机、Safari、Firefox 不支持 Web Serial 刷机）及一根支持数据传输的 USB 线（纯充电线不可用）。先拔下鸣片的 USB 线。
say.en: You will need a computer running Chrome or Edge (phones, Safari, and Firefox do not support Web Serial USB flashing) and a USB data cable (not charge-only). Start by unplugging your Cardenza.

say.zh: 按住侧面 {{key:HOME}} 键将 USB 线接入电脑，约 2 秒后松开。此时屏幕保持黑屏，说明设备已进入下载烧录模式。
say.en: Hold the side {{key:HOME}} button while plugging the USB cable into your computer, then release after two seconds. The screen stays blank to show the chip is waiting in download mode.

say.zh: 在 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开 [stage.203.io/recover](https://stage.203.io/recover)，点击页面顶部的「刷入最新启动器」。（请勿误点下方的完整恢复刷机，后者会清空设备内部闪存。）
say.en: Open [stage.203.io/recover](https://stage.203.io/recover) in Chrome or Edge and click Flash the newest Launcher at the top. (Avoid the full recovery option lower down unless you want to wipe internal flash.)

say.zh: 在浏览器弹出的串口列表中选择 USB JTAG/serial debug unit 并点击「连接」。若未出现该端口，请重新按住 {{key:HOME}} 插线，或更换数据线与 USB 接口。识别成功后，在弹窗中点击「刷入最新启动器」开始写入。
say.en: Select USB JTAG/serial debug unit from the browser's port chooser and click Connect. If it does not appear, re-enter download mode (hold {{key:HOME}} while plugging in) or try another data cable or USB port. Once detected, click Flash the newest Launcher in the dialog to begin.

say.zh: 网页会下载最新启动器、校验分区表，仅覆写引导程序与启动器并自动重启，全程通常不到 1 分钟。期间切勿拔线或关闭网页，看到「启动器已从 0.2.0 更新到 0.3.2」即表示完成。
say.en: The page downloads the latest Launcher, inspects the partition table, writes only the bootloader and Launcher, verifies them, and reboots the device (usually under a minute). Keep the cable connected and the tab open until you see a confirmation like "The Launcher went from 0.2.0 to 0.3.2".

say.zh: 若屏幕尚未自动点亮，拔下 USB 线重插一次即可进入新版启动器，原有固件与文件全部保留。今后可直接在主屏末张卡片「Launcher 更新」中在线升级。
say.en: Unplug and reconnect USB if the screen has not already woken up. The updated Launcher boots with all your firmware and files intact, and future updates can be installed directly from the Update Launcher card.

say.zh: 当网站检测到连接的启动器（或「我的设备」中绑定的设备）低于 0.3.1 时，会自动弹出「启动器版本过旧」提示，点击「用 USB 线刷成最新启动器」即可按以上流程一键更新。
say.en: If the website detects a Launcher older than 0.3.1 (connected over USB or listed in My devices), it displays a "The Launcher is too old" notice with a Flash the newest Launcher over USB button that guides you through these same steps.

lead.zh: Cardenza Synth 是鸣片官方固件，所有新版本均发布在 203 社区。升级仅替换固件本身，SD 卡上的工程、音色、采样与设置保持不变。
lead.en: Cardenza Synth is the official firmware, released on the 203 Community. Updating replaces only the firmware binary, leaving all projects, presets, samples, and settings on your SD card untouched.

say.zh: 先返回启动器：Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起按侧面 {{key:HOME}} 键，用 {{key:.}} 选「返回启动器」并按 {{key:OK}}；更早版本请拔下 USB 线、按住 {{key:FN}} 重新插上，见主屏后松开（参考[更新启动器](/guide/update-launcher/)第 1–2 步）。
say.en: First, return to the Launcher: on Cardenza Synth 0.2.1+, press {{key:HOME}}, scroll with {{key:.}} to Back to Launcher, and press {{key:OK}}. On older versions, unplug USB, hold {{key:FN}}, plug back in, and release when the Launcher appears (see steps 1–2 of [Updating the Launcher](/guide/update-launcher/)).

say.zh: 0.3.2 起有新版时会自动提醒：在「本地应用」和「应用商店」中，Cardenza Synth 会置顶并在封面左上角以绿色显示新版号（如 `↑0.2.1`）。在本地应用按 {{key:OK}} 仍会启动旧版，安装新版请前往「应用商店」。
say.en: On Launcher 0.3.2+, available updates stand out immediately: Cardenza Synth sorts to the front of My Apps and the Store with a green badge like `↑0.2.1` on the top-left corner of its cover. Pressing {{key:OK}} in My Apps still launches your installed version; install the update from the Store.

say.zh: Wi-Fi 在线升级（适用全部启动器）：进入「应用商店」（0.3.1 及更早称「下载软件」），按 {{key:;}} 移至顶部工具栏，选中最右侧「更新」并按 {{key:OK}}（首次使用需先连 Wi-Fi），选择「安装更新」即可覆盖旧版并重启。
say.en: Easiest method on Wi-Fi (any Launcher): open Store (called Download Software on 0.3.1 and older), press {{key:;}} to jump to the top toolbar, scroll right to Updates, and press {{key:OK}}. Join Wi-Fi if prompted, then choose Install update to replace the old version and reboot.

say.zh: 如需指定渠道（如开发版）：在应用商店选中 Cardenza Synth 按 {{key:OK}}，选择稳定版或开发版并选中原槽位；弹出「替换？」（默认光标在「返回」）时按 {{key:,}} 选「替换」并按 {{key:OK}}。（0.2.0 旧版启动器为 Cardenza Synth → 版本 → Install。）
say.en: To choose a specific channel (such as dev), select Cardenza Synth in the Store, press {{key:OK}}, pick stable or dev, and select the existing slot. When "Replace?" appears (defaulting to Back), press {{key:,}} to select Replace and press {{key:OK}}. (On Launcher 0.2.0, open Cardenza Synth → version → Install.)

say.zh: 无 Wi-Fi 时可通过电脑更新：在 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开 [Cardenza Synth 社区页面](https://stage.203.io/V6QK28)，选好稳定版或开发版后点击「用 USB 线安装」，无需登录且兼容所有启动器。
say.en: Without Wi-Fi, open [Cardenza Synth's community page](https://stage.203.io/V6QK28) in Chrome or Edge on a computer, pick stable or dev, and click Install over USB. Works on any Launcher with no account required.

say.zh: 用 USB 线连接开机状态的鸣片并点击「连接设备并安装」（运行中的固件会被自动重启至启动器）。按提示允许 MIDI 权限并首次选择 USB JTAG/serial debug unit，写入完成后自动启动新版本。若已登录账号（0.3.0+），还可一键点击「绑定到我的账号」。
say.en: Connect your powered-on Cardenza over USB and click Connect and install (the page automatically reboots running firmware into the Launcher). Allow MIDI if prompted and select USB JTAG/serial debug unit the first time. After flashing, it boots straight into the new version. If signed in (Launcher 0.3.0+), you can also click Bind to my account in one step.

say.zh: 0.3.2 起 USB 安装会自动覆盖旧版并在网页显示「已替换」及版本号。更早版本会在空闲空间另装一份，可在已装软件中选中旧版，按 {{key:/}} 至 ⋯ 按 {{key:OK}} 删除（若闪存空间不足，请先删旧版或升级启动器）。
say.en: On Launcher 0.3.2+, USB installs overwrite the old version automatically and show "Replaced" with both version numbers. Older Launchers install a second copy in free space; to remove the old one, highlight it in Software Launcher, press {{key:/}} to ⋯, press {{key:OK}}, and choose Delete (or update the Launcher first if flash space is full).

say.zh: 已绑定账号的设备（0.3.0+，绑定步骤见[更新启动器](/guide/update-launcher/)第 5 步）登录后，页面主按钮会变为绿色「升级」（未安装时为「下载并安装」）。设备连着 Wi-Fi 处于启动器或运行 Cardenza Synth 0.2.2+ 时（后者自动存盘并退回启动器；更早版本请先按 {{key:HOME}} 返回启动器）会自动无线升级并重启；若当时离线，重新上线后按 {{key:OK}} 确认「安装来自社区的固件？」即可。
say.en: If your Cardenza is linked to your account (Launcher 0.3.0+; see step 5 of [Updating the Launcher](/guide/update-launcher/)), signing in turns the main button into a green Upgrade button (or Download & install if not installed). While on Wi-Fi in the Launcher or running Cardenza Synth 0.2.2+ (which saves your session and reboots to the Launcher; on older versions, press {{key:HOME}} and choose Back to Launcher first), it downloads, replaces the old version, and launches automatically. If it was offline when queued, confirm "Install from the community?" with {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: 使用 `.bin` 离线安装（兼容全部启动器）：点击「用 USB 线安装」旁的 ▾ 菜单，选择「下载 .bin 到电脑」。
say.en: To install manually from a `.bin` file (any Launcher), open the ▾ menu beside Install over USB and select Download the .bin to this computer.

say.zh: 打开启动器「U盘模式」（USB Drive，0.3.0 及更早叫 USB 模式）将 SD 卡挂载至电脑，拷入 `.bin` 文件后安全弹出并按 {{key:ESC}}。随后进入「文件浏览」（Files），选中该文件按 {{key:OK}}（安装）覆盖旧版本位置。
say.en: Open USB Drive in the Launcher (USB Mode on 0.3.0 and older) to mount the SD card on your computer, copy the `.bin` file over, safely eject the drive, and press {{key:ESC}}. Then open Files, select the `.bin`, press {{key:OK}} (Install), and choose the existing slot to replace it.

lead.zh: 203 社区汇集了开发者制作的各类第三方合成器、音序器、小游戏与工具。安装后与 Cardenza Synth 并存，可随时在「本地应用」中切换运行。
lead.en: Explore third-party synths, sequencers, games, and utilities on the 203 Community. Community apps install alongside Cardenza Synth and can be switched anytime from My Apps.

say.zh: 在电脑上打开 [203 社区固件列表](https://stage.203.io/firmware)，左侧筛选 Cardenza 并点开感兴趣的应用（如 GLIDE）。社区固件未经 203 官方审核，安装前请先阅读介绍与讨论。
say.en: Open the [203 Community firmware catalog](https://stage.203.io/firmware) on a computer, filter by Cardenza on the left, and pick an app such as GLIDE. Community firmware is not reviewed by 203 Systems, so read the description and comments before installing.

say.zh: 最简便的方式是在 Chrome / Edge 中点击「用 USB 线安装」→「连接设备并安装」（免登录，兼容全部启动器）。新固件会安装到空闲空间，不会影响 Cardenza Synth，装完自动启动。
say.en: The fastest method is clicking Install over USB → Connect and install in Chrome or Edge (no account needed, works on any Launcher). The app installs into free space without touching Cardenza Synth and launches automatically.

say.zh: 切换回其他固件：先返回启动器（支持系统菜单的按 {{key:HOME}} 选「返回启动器」，无系统菜单的拔线按住 {{key:FN}} 重插），再在「本地应用」（My Apps）中选择目标固件按 {{key:OK}}。
say.en: To switch back to another app, return to the Launcher (press {{key:HOME}} → Back to Launcher if supported, or unplug, hold {{key:FN}}, and plug back in), open My Apps, pick an app, and press {{key:OK}}.

say.zh: Wi-Fi 在线安装（启动器 0.3.0 起）：打开「应用商店」（Store）浏览社区精选，选中目标按 {{key:OK}} 并选择渠道；提示选择安装位置时选「空闲空间」以免覆盖其他应用。
say.en: On Wi-Fi (Launcher 0.3.0+), open the Store to browse featured community apps. Select an app, press {{key:OK}}, choose a channel, and press {{key:OK}}. If prompted for an install slot, choose Free space so you do not overwrite existing apps.

say.zh: 未入选精选的应用可使用其社区页面标注的 6 位代码查找（例如 GLIDE 为 `B6S4QV`）。
say.en: If an app is not featured in the Store list, grab its 6-character code from its community page (for example, `B6S4QV` for GLIDE).

say.zh: 0.3.1 起在应用商店直接键入代码即可置顶目标并按 {{key:OK}}；0.3.0 请按 {{key:;}} 移至顶部工具栏选 #（代码）输入；0.2.0 不支持代码检索，请改用电脑 USB 安装。
say.en: On Launcher 0.3.1+, just start typing the code in the Store to bring the app to the top and press {{key:OK}}. On Launcher 0.3.0, press {{key:;}} to reach the top toolbar, select # Code, enter it, and press {{key:OK}}. Launcher 0.2.0 does not support codes; install via computer instead.

say.zh: 已绑定账号的设备（0.3.0+，见[更新启动器](/guide/update-launcher/)第 5 步）登录后，可直接点击固件页面的「下载并安装」。设备在启动器连网或运行 Cardenza Synth 0.2.2+ 时会自动无线下载安装（其他运行中的固件需先退回启动器）；若当时离线，重新上线后按 {{key:OK}} 确认安装提示即可。
say.en: If your device is linked to your account (Launcher 0.3.0+; see step 5 of [Updating the Launcher](/guide/update-launcher/)), click Download & install on the app's page while signed in. On Wi-Fi in the Launcher or running Cardenza Synth 0.2.2+ (other running apps must return to the Launcher first), it downloads, installs, and launches automatically. If it was offline, confirm "Install from the community?" with {{key:OK}} when back online.

say.zh: 通过 `.bin` 安装（适用全部启动器）：点击 ▾ →「下载 .bin 到电脑」，在「U盘模式」拷入 SD 卡并弹出，按 ESC 返回后于「文件浏览」选中并按 OK 安装至空闲空间。若不慎刷入异常固件导致无法开机，请使用[恢复刷机](https://stage.203.io/recover)（会清空已装固件）。
say.en: To install from a `.bin` file (any Launcher), choose ▾ → Download the .bin to this computer, copy it to the SD card via USB Drive (USB Mode on 0.3.0 and older), eject, press ESC, then open Files, highlight the `.bin`, and press OK (Install) into free space. If an app breaks booting, use [Recovery flash](https://stage.203.io/recover) (erases installed apps).

lead.zh: 在电脑与鸣片 SD 卡间互传工程、采样或 `.bin` 固件文件。
lead.en: Transfer projects, samples, or `.bin` firmware between your computer and Cardenza's SD card.

say.zh: 在启动器主屏进入「U盘模式」（USB Drive，0.3.0 及更早叫 USB 模式），按 {{key:OK}} 并连接电脑，SD 卡即作为移动磁盘挂载。
say.en: Open USB Drive from the Launcher home screen (USB Mode on 0.3.0 and older), press {{key:OK}}, and plug into your computer. The SD card mounts as a standard removable drive.

say.zh: 文件传输完毕后，请先在电脑端安全弹出磁盘，再按 {{key:ESC}} 退出 U盘模式。若电脑仍在占用磁盘，启动器会先行提示以防文件损坏。
say.en: After copying files, safely eject the drive on your computer before pressing {{key:ESC}} to return to the Launcher. If the computer is still accessing the drive, the Launcher warns you to prevent corrupting files.

say.zh: 安装卡内的 `.bin` 固件：进入「文件浏览」（Files），选中文件后按 {{key:OK}}（右侧带 ↓ 图标），随后与商店一致选择安装位置即可。
say.en: To install a `.bin` firmware from the SD card, open Files, highlight the file, press {{key:OK}} (marked with ↓ on the right), and pick an install slot just like in the Store.

say.zh: 也可以跳过 U盘模式，在 Chrome 或 Edge 中打开[设备文件](https://stage.203.io/files)：让鸣片停留在启动器主界面并连接 USB，点击「连接设备」即可直接在浏览器中浏览、上传和下载 SD（TF）卡文件。
say.en: Alternatively, skip USB Drive and open [Device files](https://stage.203.io/files) in Chrome or Edge. Leave Cardenza on the Launcher home screen, connect USB, and click Connect device to browse, upload, and download SD card files directly from the browser.

lead.zh: 设备无法开机、刷机异常或希望恢复出厂状态时，可通过网页 USB 一键重刷官方启动器与官方固件，无需登录。
lead.en: Restore the official Launcher and firmware over USB if your device won't boot or you want a clean factory reset. No account required.

say.zh: 在 Chrome 或 Edge 打开[恢复刷机](https://stage.203.io/recover)并选择 Cardenza。恢复刷机会清空内部闪存（全部已装固件、启动器设置、已存 Wi-Fi 与账号绑定，后续可重新绑定），SD 卡内的工程、音色与采样完好保留。
say.en: Open [Recovery flash](https://stage.203.io/recover) in Chrome or Edge and choose Cardenza. Recovery erases internal flash (all installed firmware, Launcher settings, saved Wi-Fi, and account link, which you can re-link later), while leaving projects, presets, and samples on your SD card untouched.

say.zh: 若设备仍能开机：停在启动器并连接电脑，点击连接时网页会自动引导重启进入下载模式；运行带系统菜单的固件（Cardenza Synth 0.2.1 起）也可按 {{key:HOME}} 直接选择末项「下载模式」。
say.en: If the device still boots, stay in the Launcher and plug into your computer; clicking Connect reboots it into download mode automatically. On firmware with a system menu (Cardenza Synth 0.2.1+), you can also press {{key:HOME}} and select Download mode.

say.zh: 若无法开机：拔下 USB 线，按住侧面 {{key:HOME}} 键重新插上并在 2 秒后松开，屏幕保持黑屏即表示已进入下载模式。
say.en: If the device will not boot, unplug USB, hold the side {{key:HOME}} button while plugging it back in, and release after two seconds. The screen stays blank while it waits in download mode.

say.zh: 点击「选择串口并连接」，选中设备串口（通常为 USB JTAG/serial debug unit），勾选确认框后点击「擦除并恢复」。刷写期间切勿拔线或关闭网页；完成后会自动进入官方启动器（若勾选了「同时装上 Cardenza Synth」则一并预装完成）。
say.en: Click Choose the port and connect, pick the device port (usually USB JTAG/serial debug unit), check the confirmation box, and click Erase and restore. Keep the cable plugged in and the page open until it finishes. Cardenza then boots into the official Launcher (with Cardenza Synth pre-installed if you checked Install “Cardenza Synth” too).
